title.en: Cupcake Liner Sizes Chart: How to Choose the Right Baking Cup
title.zh: 蛋糕纸托尺寸对照表：如何选择合适的烘焙纸杯

description.en: A buyer’s outline for comparing liner dimensions, checking tray fit and preparing a size specification for a wholesale inquiry.
description.zh: 从底径、高度、口径和烤盘适配入手，整理适合批量采购的纸托尺寸需求。

bodyEn:
## Start with the finished product

Writing outline: identify what you bake, how it will be displayed, and whether you use a supporting tray. Describe the intended use before comparing liner sizes.

Draft paragraph: We offer a wide range of prints and colors and support custom requirements. Confirm the exact cup and tray combination with a physical sample before placing an order.
